claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Gabexate is a short-lived, highly polar serine protease inhibitor that is not expected to kill cancer cells at 2.5 uM; any apparent activity would reflect weak, non-selective antiproliferative effects rather than a specific cytotoxic mechanism.
